r1293.finding: E267 swept the clearance rule donor_p95 > t*(1+b) over four rules (own-side guard on/off x t_side/t_max_end) on E266's 36 published comparisons. The binding fact is that separability is decided by the LARGEST non-move, not the nearest: the nearest non-move clears its threshold by 0.0443 against the nearest move's 0.0455 (a 0.0012 gap that invites 'a tiny buffer separates them'), but one non-move clears by 2.4595 (246%), so any b that clears every non-move (b=2.46) clears every move too -> separable=false, separating_b_window=null. r1319.finding: Both margins looked 'one rung away'. Priced off the published ladder (E256: 14 rungs x 6 draw counts, base 60, prefix-nested per seed) they are two different questions. GRANULARITY is generous: 70 adjacent steps, median gain 1.069853, range 1.000000..1.258868, and 37 of 70 buy more than the widening margin on their own -- so a finer grid cannot be the fix. HEADROOM is not: the ladder spans 1.000000..1.925449 central (2.427092 at tail|100|1920 widest seed, whose central reading is 1.115094), so on the central basis no rung crosses. Which demands may be graded is a WINDOW question: only 3 of the 12 rows live in era_2025_now, the ladder's own cell. There the widening margin is 5.9828 pct (star_lag1_residual|60|14 flip 2.380091, nearest rung 1.925449, residual 1.236123, crossed at one seed only) and the narrowing margin 3.5395 pct (self|60|8 flip 0.889387) against a ladder that publishes no sub-1.0 reading at all (residual 1.124370 against its own 1.0 floor). E287's headline pair (3.799212 / 3.669343 pct) is a cross-window subtraction -- the widening demand is all_five and the cap was written at early_three|60 -- so it is quoted as the margin's denominator, never as a cap the ladder replaces. Verdict one_margin_is_crossed_by_a_single_seed_rung_only, 2 of 2 interpolations aborted.
r1319.pit: (1) 'the margin is smaller than one step' answers a resolution question and says nothing about headroom -- publishing only the step number invites the wrong fix (grind the grid finer) when the ladder already stops 24 pct short; the face prices both and they disagree. (2) a margin is a subtraction, so both terms carry a window: grading a demand from all_five against a ladder measured in era_2025_now prices a different sleeve's null (E258's BASIS_WARNING, >15 pct between windows), and the same-family margin moves 3.80 -> 5.98 pct just by reading it where the ladder lives; the 9 rows with no ladder are published as not_graded with the reason, never as crossings or shortfalls. (3) matched-seed pairing matters: max(top)/min(base) splices two seeds into a multiplier nobody measured, so per-seed ratios are paired index by index and a mismatched vector is refused. (4) the same-window reproduction witness caught nothing only because it was checked at all -- E258 1.644145 vs the ladder rung 1.644145, |diff| 0.0.

r1321.finding: E290 handed the 301 un-derivable counts on as "the face already publishes this unit elsewhere, so move the count". Priced row by row, that plan mostly does not exist: 24 rows name the unit AS the key (no sibling list of that name can ever sit in the same parent), 76 have the unit published in more than one scope (a choice, not a move), and of the 201 single-target rows NOT ONE lands beside a list in its own scope or in a scope that contains / sits under it. All 126 agreements come from unrelated subtrees and every one of those target lists holds at most one item (100 pct degenerate), so the agreement is the arithmetic of a one-item list meeting a count of 1; 75 rows would instead publish a disagreement. The first build scored agreement without the scope relation and reported 126 clean / 75 convict; the declared vocabulary could not express what the data then showed, so V4 was declared and the first counts are kept in frozen_spec.vocab_amendment.
r1321.pit: (1) agreement is necessary, not sufficient -- a candidate list must be priced by WHERE it lives (same/ancestor/descendant vs face_root/unrelated) before a move is called clean, and the degenerate-target share must ship with the count or "138 of 217 move cleanly" reads as a majority finding when it is an artifact of one-element lists. (2) a bare unit name can never be relocated: if the key IS the unit there is no sibling list of that name to move beside, so those rows need their own records, not a naming change. r1322.finding: r1314 froze the BAND family census to its publish vintage so four smoke legs would stop going red on a directory that had grown -- which answered 'how do we stop the drift' but not 'did it matter'. Re-derived every directory-censusing study twice in one process (frozen vintage vs live directory): of the family's 54 study scripts only 12 glob the face directory at all (the other 42 read named sibling faces and cannot move); 9 of the 12 can be varied and every one prints the same verdict with up to 34 more faces in view (e277 34, e278 32, e281 28, e282 26, e283 24, e284 22, e286 18, e293 12, e287 10); 3 cannot be asked because their build() takes no universe argument. Verdict no_published_verdict_moves_with_the_universe -- the drift was a reproducibility problem, not a conclusion problem.
r1322.pit: (1) A freeze fixes reproducibility, not dependence: a face re-derived over its own vintage is reproducible BY CONSTRUCTION. Only a second universe tests whether the verdict was a function of the directory. (2) A study that owns a freeze switch must be driven through it -- the first build passed a staged directory to build(outdir, extend) while leaving extend=False, i.e. ran the same frozen computation twice and manufactured four stable verdicts (the exact tautology E294 exists to catch; the smoke leg now requires ' vs ' in every measured row's varied text). (3) Ask how much of the family the question can reach -- 'the family is unaffected' conflates the 42 studies that read named faces (immovable by construction) with the 12 that were measured. (4) Operational: the first in-process build wedged on one study and took the whole census with it (cancelled after 5 min of silence), so each study now runs in its own child process under a wall-clock cap and a cap that fires is published as not_measurable, not silently dropped. (5) Self-inclusion: the face is itself BAND*, so its own two files are excluded from the census and the exclusion is a leg. (6) The family glob BAND*.json is case-insensitive here, so band*_latest.json mirrors are inside every study's universe -- disclosed, not narrowed, because narrowing it would change all of them.
